transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I advocate for ethical practices and compliance in the library management system. My requirements ensure data protection (RES-01), promote accessibility (RES-02), and maintain accountability through logging (RES-03). Furthermore, enforcing borrowing limits (RES-04) and notifying members about overdue books (RES-05) fosters responsible usage. I also emphasize the importance of a feedback mechanism (RES-06) and annual usage reporting (RES-07) for transparency and fairness. These requirements are essential for building trust and ensuring that the system serves all community members equitably.

transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the importance of security and privacy in the library management system. My requirements ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books (TRU-01), that all transactions are logged for auditability (TRU-02), and that personal information is encrypted (TRU-03). These requirements are vital for protecting user data and maintaining trust in the system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books securely.
The system shall log all borrowing transactions and user actions for auditability and accountability.
The system shall implement data encryption for all member personal information stored.
The system shall enforce a maximum borrowing limit of 5 books per member, allowing exceptions based on user history.
The system shall provide a mechanism to notify members of overdue books within 24 hours.
The system shall allow members to update their personal information securely.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users to promote fairness and inclusivity.
The system shall allow librarians to manage book inventory effectively with minimal latency.
The system shall ensure high availability with an uptime of 99.5%.
The system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient infrastructure.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues regarding library services.
The system shall provide annual reports on usage statistics for transparency.
The system shall allow digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
The system shall track energy usage continuously to optimize operations.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data.
The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
The system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
The system shall allow members to check the carbon footprint of each book.
